source_name: TED Open Data Service
why_relevant: TED's own open-data front end, exposing notices as structured/linked data for reuse. Alternative to the Search API when RDF/SPARQL-style querying or dataset snapshots are preferable.

source_name: EU Open Data Portal — TED dataset (CSV subset of contract and award notices)
why_relevant: Pre-flattened CSV extract of the most important TED contract notice / contract award notice fields (buyer, value, winner, CPV, country). Fastest path to a first analytical cut of SI banking/payments contract values and incumbent suppliers without parsing XML.

source_name: TED — Developers' corner for reusers / data reuse pages
why_relevant: Hub page linking every reuse channel (API, bulk packages, ODS, reusers' workshops, schema changes). Best single pointer to keep the collector aligned with TED's migration from TED-schema to eForms.

source_name: SIMAP section on TED — European public procurement rules and thresholds (Slovenian version)
why_relevant: SIMAP is now folded into TED; the /sl/simap pages explain in Slovenian which contracts must be published EU-wide and at what thresholds. Defines the boundary between what appears on TED versus only on the national portal — essential for scoping coverage and for interpreting gaps.

source_name: CPV — Enotni besednjak javnih naročil (Common Procurement Vocabulary) on TED, Slovenian
why_relevant: Authoritative CPV code list with Slovenian labels. Gives the exact native wording for each target code (66100000 storitve bančništva in investicijskega bančništva, 66110000 bančne storitve, 66172000 obdelava plačilnih transakcij, 30144200 stroji za izdajanje bankovcev / bankomati), which is what makes the national-portal cross-matching and sl-language searching precise.

source_name: OP-TED eForms SDK (GitHub)
why_relevant: Ships the XML schemas (UBL 2.3 pre-award), codelists as Genericode (including CPV and country codes), notice-type JSON definitions and Schematron rules. Needed to parse eForms notice XML reliably and to map field IDs to business meaning (buyer, value, winner, framework agreement, lots).

source_name: OP-TED eForms Notice Viewer (GitHub)
why_relevant: Reference implementation that renders any eForms notice XML to HTML in a chosen language. Practical way to produce human-readable Slovenian and English renderings of collected SI notices for analyst review without building a renderer.

source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (SEDIA) — calls for tenders and grants
why_relevant: Single electronic data interchange area for EU-managed procurement and funding. Relevant to the SI cell for two things: EU-institution procurement that Slovenian banking/payments vendors can bid on, and EU-funded programmes (digitalisation, e-government, payments infrastructure) whose Slovenian beneficiaries later run national tenders — an early-warning layer ahead of TED notices.

source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal search API (SEDIA JSON endpoint)
why_relevant: Programmatic route to the F&T Portal's opportunity and project data, widely used by third-party integrators. Would let the collector track EU-funded projects with Slovenian banking/payments relevance systematically rather than by hand.

source_name: Publications Office — public procurement / procurement-details pages (op.europa.eu)
why_relevant: Publications Office renders individual EU procurement records with buyer, CPV, award method, estimated and final contract value. A confirmed Slovenian banking-services example was found here (Aerodrom/Brnik, CPV 66110000, awarded to SKB d.d.), demonstrating it as a usable secondary rendering of TED data with clean value fields.

source_name: OPSI — Odprti podatki Slovenije: Zbirka objavljenih odločitev o oddaji javnega naročila
why_relevant: Slovenian national open-data dataset of published award decisions. Provides an independent, structured, Slovenian-side check on the TED award-notice set — catching awards that were decided but where the EU-level award notice is late, missing or differently coded.

source_name: Commercial TED aggregators (TenderWolf, TenderMetric, TenderDetail, TenderRadar)
why_relevant: Re-publishers of TED data with CPV- and country-scoped landing pages (e.g. a Slovenia EU-tenders page and a CPV 66110000 banking-services page). Valuable mainly as discovery aids and as sanity checks on CPV coverage; not a substitute for the official feed and subject to paywalls.

source_name: Evropska sredstva (evropskasredstva.si) - official SI cohesion policy 2021-2027 portal
why_relevant: Successor/companion to eu-skladi.si and the official managing-authority portal for the 2021-2027 European Cohesion Policy Programme in Slovenia. Publishes javni razpisi/javni pozivi, the implementation-system description (OSUN), selection criteria and beneficiary/operation lists. Cohesion-funded IT and digitalisation operations touching financial infrastructure (SID banka financial instruments, Sklad skladov) are announced and later reported here, and it points onward to Uradni list and to the sectoral ministries that actually run the calls.

source_name: eu-skladi.si - legacy Slovenian EU cohesion funds portal (2014-2020 and archive)
why_relevant: Historical and still-referenced portal of the Government Office for Development and European Cohesion Policy (SVRK). Holds the archive of prior-period calls, beneficiary lists and decisions on co-financing (e.g. SME digital transformation calls funded from ESRR). Useful as the retrospective baseline against which current award activity in financial-sector digitalisation is compared, and as an alias/redirect pointer to evropskasredstva.si.

source_name: Urad RS za okrevanje in odpornost (URSOO) / Načrt za okrevanje in odpornost on GOV.SI
why_relevant: URSOO (body within the Ministry of Finance) is the coordinating authority for Slovenia's RRF plan and holds the plan text, its addenda and the mapping of components/investments (including digitalisation of public administration and the economy) to responsible ministries. It is the authoritative index for deciding which ministry will publish which digitalisation call, and therefore where to point downstream tender monitors.

source_name: EBRD Procurement Notices (project procurement, corporate and consultancy)
why_relevant: EBRD publishes its own procurement and consultant-selection notices outside the national regime, in English, and these include assignments for Slovenian financial institutions and the central bank. A concrete EBRD procurement document for a 'Bank of Slovenia risk appetite framework' assignment was surfaced, evidencing that SI financial-sector consultancy work does flow through this channel. Award/contract information from IFIs is an independent evidence stream naming winning advisers and vendors.

source_name: EBRD Client e-Procurement Portal (ECEPP)
why_relevant: ECEPP is where EBRD clients post the operational procurement notices for EBRD loan- or grant-financed contracts - the actual tender opportunities, and in many cases the contract-award records. For any EBRD-financed Slovenian financial-institution project, ECEPP rather than the national portal is where the notice appears first.

source_name: EBRD Slovenia country page and project summary documents (PSD)
why_relevant: Upstream signal: EBRD project summary documents disclose financing to Slovenian financial institutions before any procurement happens, so they forecast where donor-financed IT/digitalisation spend will land. A 'Framework for Financing Financial Institutions in Slovenia' PSD (up to EUR 50m debt/equity/quasi-equity to selected Slovenian banks) was identified, which is exactly the kind of facility that later generates advisory and technical-cooperation procurement.

source_name: EIB project database - Slovenia / SID banka intermediated loan operations
why_relevant: EIB discloses each financing operation with SID banka and other Slovenian counterparties (loan facilities, municipal infrastructure, social housing intermediated framework loans). These operations set the terms under which SID banka must then run its own selection of financial intermediaries and its own procurement, so the EIB project pages are the upstream index for a downstream Slovenian tender stream. Also carries EIB procurement/consultancy notices for the Bank's own contracts.

source_name: EIF calls for expression of interest - selection of financial intermediaries (incl. Slovenia-specific SEGIP)
why_relevant: The EIF's competitive selection of financial intermediaries is the donor-side analogue of a tender: published calls, deadlines, and named selected intermediaries. SEGIP (Slovene Equity Growth Investment Programme, EUR 100m, funded jointly by SID banka and EIF) has its own dedicated Slovenia calls, e.g. SEGIP 2025/01 - VC Fund, applications opened 11 Feb 2025 with deadline 30 June 2026. The 'EIF intermediaries in Slovenia' page is effectively an award list for the Slovenian financial sector.

source_name: Sklad skladov (Fund of Funds, SID banka) - Javna naročila in pozivi
why_relevant: Sklad skladov deploys EU cohesion money through financial intermediaries and publishes both its public procurements and its calls, together with the record of concluded procurements naming the selected intermediaries for each financial instrument. This is a highly targeted, EU-fund-financed procurement channel sitting squarely inside the Slovenian banking sector - exactly the cell's remit, and one that never appears as a classic EU tender notice.

source_name: SID banka - Javna naročila and Informacije javnega značaja
why_relevant: SID banka is the Slovenian promotional/export bank and the domestic counterparty for EIB, EIF and cohesion money. It publishes its own public procurement notices (including IT/system procurement for a bank) and its calls for fund managers and intermediaries, plus an informacije javnega značaja page that as a public-information duty typically lists concluded contracts. Direct award evidence for a systemically relevant SI financial institution.

source_name: SPIRIT Slovenija - razpisi (implementing agency for NOO/EKP business digitalisation calls)
why_relevant: SPIRIT is a recurring executing body (izvajalec) for RRF- and cohesion-financed calls on digital transformation and large investments. It hosts the full call documentation packs (PDF), which name the funding component, the co-financing rate and the eligible technology categories - the level of detail needed to judge whether payments/fintech scope is in play. Calls addressed to enterprises also reach fintech and payment-service companies.
